sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to find yourself at odds with people today, says Ganesha. Avoid confrontations and arguments as it may lead to serious fights. Legal issues may creep up unexpectedly. Relax and spend some time with yourself to return to your charm and cheer. Delay the inauguration of important activities for another day, recommends Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: If you've asked your employer for a raise recently, Taurus, the astral energy indicates that you can expect to receive one soon. Your employer is greatly impressed with your efforts, and probably thinking that you might be setting your sights elsewhere. Opportunities may certainly appear, although this is obviously not the time to decide. Take some time to really think and consider everything carefully.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Acknowledge and release emotional blockages as Luna aspects the nodes of fate before exiting your sign. The Gemini Moon aligns with Mars, Neptune, and Pluto as afternoon unfolds, expanding your capacity to act on your dreams. If you feel overwhelmed or unmotivated, inhale determination and exhale apprehension. Smart moves offer instant gratification once Luna and Uranus join forces later tonight. Steady your thoughts then take a leap of faith to harness these vibes.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: A beneficial day to work on things that will improve your health. Enjoy a peaceful and quiet day with family members-If people approach you with problems- Ignore them and don't let this bother your mind. Natives of this zodiac sign must refrain from speaking more than required at the workplace, as their image can get negatively affected. Businessmen of this sign are likely to incur losses today due to any old investment. Students of this zodiac sign will waste their time majorly on TV or mobile phone more than required. This will lead to wastage of time. Today, your spouse might show you his/her not-so-good side.

readings.text: You will be having a positive day at the workplace. You will be able to accomplish your pending tasks and successfully achieve your targets. Post lunch, you will impress your boss and colleagues with your crazy, exciting yet result-oriented new ideas.

The week starts out on a rather discombobulated note. Everyone around you seems to be a little off kilter thanks to the weekend before. Nothing seems to fit into place and people's actions are haphazard. Be prepared for just about anything.

Continue looking for the positive in all that you do. When you give yourself positive reinforcement for healthful actions, you are more apt to take these steps in the future. When you go for a glass of water (particularly when you are not thirsty), try telling yourself why it is good for you with a soothing tone. Your inner voice plays a great role in how you treat yourself. Make it loud and reassuring.
